title: QueryListV2
description: Output of QueryGeneratorAgent: query groups derived from the user understanding. Each group is one retrieval direction with concrete search-keyword strings.

queryGroups.description: One entry per retrieval direction. At most 8 groups: emit all target-only category groups first, followed by cross groups ordered by editorial value.

groupId.description: Stable id, e.g. g1, g2, in emission order.

linkedInterestNames.description: Interest Name(s) this group serves, copied verbatim. 1 entry = single-interest group, 2+ = blended.

userIntent.description: 1-2 sentences describing the user's understanding of THIS group's domain — their expertise, how deep they follow it, and what they want from it. For a cross group, fuse the linked interests' Descriptions into the user's angle on the intersection; for a deep group, carry the target interest's Description. This replaces the old intent enum: it is the natural-language statement of intent the downstream steps read.

items.description: One search-engine query string (3-10 tokens, no date operators, no year, no quotes, no boolean operators).

searchKeywords.description: Concrete search query strings. Length min(8, 2 + n), n = total Keywords count of the linked interests; floor 3, ceiling 8. Each hits a different angle.

freshnessPriority.description: How recent the group's content needs to be. The recency window is applied in code. Shared by all keywords in the group.

aiRelated.description: True if this query group is fundamentally about AI / machine learning / LLMs / generative-AI tools or the AI industry. This feed deprioritizes AI groups (at most one is kept, ranked last).

crossNovelty.description: How novel / unexpected / 'fancy' this group's cross is. 1.0 = a surprising, delightful intersection of the target with a distinctive profile interest; 0.3 = an obvious/plain angle on the target; 0.0 = generic. Used to diversify the group set so it is not dominated by AI/Tech angles.
